text.en: This Order may be cited as the Universiti Brunei Darussalam (Amendment . of Schedule) Order, 2006. Amendment of section 15 of Schedule of Chapter 157.

Section 15 of the Schedule to the U niversiti Brunei Darussalam Act, is amended in paragraph {e) of subsection 11), by deleting "not more than five (5) persons" and by substituting "such number of persons as may be" therefor. Made this 9th. day of Ramadan, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 2nd. day of October, 2006 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh AWANG MOHIDIN BIN HAJI DAUD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
